realigned_rows_note: FY2006 release (8-K 17-Nov-2006, Ex. 99.1) EBITDA As Defined reconciliation: the row 'Non-Recurring IPO Costs (6)' prints three cells for four columns ('— | 2,650 | —'). The fifty-two-week 2006 Gross Adjustments of $60,159k = sum of the other items ($57,509k) + $2,650k, so the value belongs to FY2006 (twelve months); extract.py right-aligns short rows in that table.

guidance_fy27.src: Q4 FY26 release (8-K 10-Nov-2026, Ex. 99.1), 'Fiscal 2027 Outlook' and Table 6 (guidance midpoint reconciliation)
guidance_fy27.markets: Commercial OEM revenue growth in the high single-digit to low double-digit percentage range; commercial aftermarket revenue growth in the high single-digit percentage range; defense revenue growth in the high single-digit percentage range.
guidance_fy27.history: FY26 guidance: 12-Nov-2025 initial; raised 3-Feb-2026, 5-May-2026 (net sales $10,300-10,420m, EBITDA As Defined $5,370-5,470m, adjusted EPS $38.83-40.21) and 4-Aug-2026 (net sales $10,470-10,550m, EBITDA As Defined $5,490-5,550m, adjusted EPS $40.62-41.46). FY26 actual: net sales $10,557m, EBITDA As Defined $5,563m, adjusted EPS $41.35.

deals.prince_izant: Prince & Izant (brazing alloys and specialty metal components; Power & Control): agreement 27-Jul-2026 (8-K); closed 28-Sep-2026 for ~$1,058m net of cash acquired (FY2026 10-K). Expected calendar-2026 revenue ~$390m (8-K 28-Sep-2026; $360m in the 27-Jul-2026 announcement).
deals.jpe_vsa: Jet Parts Engineering and Victor Sierra Aviation (PMA commercial aftermarket; Power & Control): closed 7-Apr-2026 for ~$2,142m net of cash acquired (FY2026 10-K); ~95% / 96% acquired (redeemable NCI). Calendar-2025 revenue ~$280m (8-K 16-Jan-2026 / 7-Apr-2026).
deals.simmonds: Simmonds Precision Products (from RTX; Power & Control): closed 6-Oct-2025 for ~$757m (FY2026 10-K); expected calendar-2025 revenue ~$350m (8-K 6-Oct-2025).
deals.stellant: Stellant Systems: agreement 31-Dec-2025 (~$960m); TransDigm withdrew 13-Jul-2026 (8-K) - not modelled.
deals.extant_assets: Extant Aerospace asset purchase (commercial rotorcraft, land systems and business-jet products incl. a California facility), ~$240m cash, agreement 21-Sep-2026, close expected in FY2027 (8-K 21-Sep-2026); revenue not disclosed.
deals.fy26_other: FY2026: twelve bolt-on 'Other Acquisitions' at the operating-unit level (FY2026 10-K); total FY2026 acquisitions ~$4.4bn net of cash.

amort_sched.src: FY2026 10-K Note 8 (intangible assets): estimated amortization expense, fiscal years ending 30 September.

debt.at_2026_09_30: Gross debt $34,124m (carrying $33,890m): securitization facility $875m (capacity $1,000m, matures 9-Jul-2027); term loans $12,803m (Tranche K $3,508m Mar-2030 SOFR+2.25%; J $3,559m Feb-2031; L $1,470m Jan-2032; M $2,475m Aug-2032; N $1,791m Feb-2033; SOFR+2.50%; ~1% p.a. amortization); notes $20,969m (2028 secured 6.750% $269m; 2029: 4.625% sub $1,200m Jan, 6.375% secured $2,750m Mar, 4.875% sub $750m May; 2030 secured 6.875% $1,450m Dec-2030; 2031 secured 7.125% $1,000m Dec-2031; 2032 secured 6.625% $2,200m Mar; 2033: 6.000% secured $1,500m Jan, 6.375% sub $2,650m May; 2034: 6.250% secured $500m Jan, 6.750% sub $2,000m Jan, 6.125% sub $1,700m Jul; 2035 secured 6.750% $3,000m Jan-2035); government refundable advances $8m; finance leases $344m. Revolver $910m undrawn ($865m available after $45m letters of credit). ~75% fixed rate.
debt.src: FY2026 10-K Note 10 (debt) and Liquidity section; 8-K 29-Sep-2026 (2035 secured notes); 8-K 13-Feb-2026 / 17-Apr-2026 (Tranche N, 6.125% 2034 notes).
debt.maturities_note: Scheduled principal by fiscal year (model input): term-loan amortization ~$130m p.a. (10-K contractual obligations: $130m within one year) plus note / tranche maturities: FY2028 2028 secured notes $269m (Aug-2028; ~$2m tendered Oct-2026); FY2029 $4,700m of 2029 notes; FY2030 Tranche K (~$3,394m after amortization, Mar-2030); FY2031 2030 secured notes $1,450m (Dec-2030) + Tranche J (~$3,476m after amortization, Feb-2031). Maturities assumed refinanced with new notes (assumption; TransDigm has refinanced every maturity since its 2006 IPO).

buyback: Existing stock repurchase program (Jan-2022, $2.2bn; increased by $5.0bn in Nov-2025, no expiration): $3,038m remaining at 30-Sep-2026 (FY2026 10-K Item 5 / Note 14). FY2026 repurchases 2,316,439 shares at an average $1,187.21 ($2,750m); Q4 FY2026 820,056 shares at $1,150.18.
dividends: No regular dividend; special cash dividends declared periodically with dividend-equivalent payments on vested options: FY2010 $7.65; FY2013 $12.85 + $22.00; FY2014 $25.00; FY2017 $24.00 + $22.00; FY2020 $32.50; FY2022 $18.50; FY2024 $35.00 (paid) and $75.00 (declared Sep-2024, paid 18-Oct-2024); FY2025 $90.00 (paid 12-Sep-2025). FY2027 Q1 dividend-equivalent payments: $54m accrued at 30-Sep-2026 (FY2026 10-K Note 9).

price.note: Exercise price of the stock options granted on 3-Nov-2026 to the CEO and directors (Forms 4 filed 5-Nov-2026; TransDigm grants options at the closing market price on the grant date) - the latest share price in an SEC filing.
